_readme: Add your own Q&A pairs here. 'questions' is a list of phrasings that should all trigger the same answer. Matching is case-insensitive and checks if the user's message contains any of the listed phrases.

faqs.answer:
🤖 I'm an A I -powered store assistant. I can help you with:

🔹 Products — prices, stock, categories
🔹 Customers — details, order history, spending
🔹 Orders — status, history per customer
🔹 Warehouse — inventory by location
🔹 Store info — return policy, shipping, payments, warranty
🔹 General questions — factual topics like science, technology, etc.

Try asking: 'Show all products', 'Orders of John Doe', or 'What is machine learning?'
🕐 Our business hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM (IST). We're closed on weekends and public holidays.
🔄 We accept returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be in original condition with receipt. Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days.
🚚 Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Free shipping on orders above ₹999. Express delivery (1 to 2 days) is available at extra cost.
💳 We accept Credit,Debit cards, UPI, Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery for eligible orders.
📞 You can reach our support team at support @ your company.com or call us at +91-XXXXXXXXXX. We respond within 24 hours.
🛡️ All electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Accessories carry a 6-month warranty. Contact support for warranty claims.
🎉 Check our website for current offers! New users get 10% offer on their first order. Subscribe to our newsletter for exclusive deals.
📦 To track your order, visit the 'My Orders' section on our website or app and enter your Order ID. You can also ask me: 'Order details of [your name]'.
🏪 We are a technology products retailer specialising in electronics and accessories. We carry laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice, cables, and more — all at competitive prices.
📋 For bulk or corporate orders, please contact our B2B team at bulk@yourcompany.com. We offer special pricing for orders of 10+ units.
